name: dash-guard
description: Refuses prose that Claude writes with an em dash, an en dash or a double hyphen, and tells Claude which lines to rewrite

banned.title: Marks to refuse
banned.description: Comma separated: em, en, double (two hyphens used as punctuation). Empty means all three.

tools.title: MCP tools to check
tools.description: A regular expression of MCP tool names whose text is checked too, such as ^mcp__notion__.*create.*$. Empty checks Write and Edit only.
